notes: The construct chain מִשְׁפַּט גֵּר יָתוֹם is rendered with *due to* twice; each relational expression belongs to its own rectum, and the ASV-italic *or* is added because the Hebrew writes no conjunction between the two nouns (rules 14, 19).
אַלְמָנָה → *the widow's* takes the determiner of the possessor (rule 29).
